what: Chat bubble line: when it enters 80% of the screen, it plays once. The face circle opens from a small circle (half the diameter) to full size in .2s, the bubble group grows from 0 to 1× in .2s, and the bubbles sway 1° → −1° → .5° → −.5° over .5s before settling. Question lines pivot on the left edge, and answer lines (look: right) pivot on the right edge, swaying from the opposite side first. This is where FAQ alternates like a conversation.

options.look: 「right」 is the answer line — pivot at the right end, with the sway direction reversed (default is the question line with a left pivot)
options.start: At what % from the top of the screen it turns on, default 80
options.--fx-icon-dur · --fx-pop-dur · --fx-rumb: Face circle open · grow · shake durations (via style), default .2s · .2s · .5s
options.--fx-tilt: Initial tilt of the shake, default 1deg — 3deg on phone (original faq-rumble-sp)
options.--fx-icon-from: Radius at which the face circle first appears, default 25%

use:
• Q Your question here
    • · Reply line: data-fx-chat-pop-rumble="look: right"

from.where: index.js .mc-fitem (FAQ question·answer speech bubbles — original faq-item.is-show: icon clip-path circle(1.5rem→3rem) .2s · balloon-wrapper .2s · balloon faq-rumble .5s, question −1 · answer +1 direction)
